ai_persona.chef_bio: Born in Naples, trained in Bologna. Crafts 72-hour cold-fermented sourdough pizza and hand-extruded bronze-die tagliatelle daily.
ai_persona.chef_philosophy: Respect the flour, San Marzano tomatoes, and aged Parmigiano Reggiano. Simplicity is perfection.
ai_persona.owner_hospitality_note: Benvenuti a Casa Bella! We treat you like family sitting around our grandmother Sunday table in Tuscany.

signature_pairings.pairing_drink: San Pellegrino Aranciata or Chianti Classico
signature_pairings.why: The crisp blistered crust and sweet San Marzano acidity require bright, effervescent notes.

signature_pairings.pairing_drink: Aged Pinot Grigio or Sparkling Botanical Tonic
signature_pairings.why: Earthy Piedmont black truffle shavings are heightened by crisp mineral undertones.
Artisanal Savoiardi biscuits soaked in Illy dark roast perfectly contrast creamy mascarpone.

secret_stories.story: Our dough undergoes 72 hours of cold fermentation using imported Italian Caputo Tipo 00 flour and baked in a 480°C volcanic stone oven.
Fresh bronze-die egg pasta made fresh every morning at 7:00 AM with imported Emilia-Romagna organic eggs.

ai_persona.spice_guidance: Italian cuisine relies on fresh herbs, cracked black pepper, and chili-infused olive oil rather than harsh chilies. All dishes are kid and family friendly.
ai_persona.dietary_rules: We offer gluten-free crust options and dedicated vegetarian pasta stations.

ai_persona.chef_bio: Master of Dum Pukht slow-cooking and Kashmiri copper deg techniques with 22 years of royal kitchen expertise.
ai_persona.chef_philosophy: Pure organic spices slow-roasted over charcoal. We never use artificial gravies, food colors, or shortcuts.
ai_persona.owner_hospitality_note: At Saffron House, our guests are treated as royal patrons. We strive to bring the forgotten heritage flavors of Awadh and Kashmir to your table.

signature_pairings.why: The cooling organic saffron yogurt cuts through the velvety richness of the single-origin dairy butter.
The 36-hour slow simmered black lentils pair harmoniously with woodfired crisp bread.
Melts on your tongue with 32 secret Lucknowi potli spices balanced by tart fresh pomegranate.

secret_stories.story: Our tomato gravy is slow-simmered for 8 hours with Kashmiri whole chilies and cold-churned white makkhan, based on Chef Sanjay grandfather 1952 recipe.
Simmered continuously over glowing tandoor charcoal embers for 36 hours with churned dairy butter and crushed fenugreek leaves.

ai_persona.spice_guidance: Our spice level 1 is gentle and aromatic; level 3 is authentic North Indian warmth; level 5 is fiery for true spice lovers.
ai_persona.dietary_rules: We maintain 100% separate dedicated cookware, grills, and oil fryers for vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes.
